name: Arcane Mafia
source:
You've just ingested enough magic drug to kill 12.5 elephants – and now the magical mafia want their merchandise back. 

You'll have to kiss your way out of this one before they abraca-kill-ya!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你刚吞下了足以毒死十二头半大象的魔药，现在，魔法黑手党找上门来要取回他们的货。

赶在他们念出“阿布拉卡——宰了你”之前，你得靠一个个吻亲出条活路！

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
